text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun tore through the Takarazuka 
Kinen at top speed, delivering remarkable 
results.

Her next target is the Tenno Sho (Autumn)! 
Rousing her spirits, she vows to dash 
through it at full throttle.

Meanwhile, having witnessed Mayano Top 
Gun's speed firsthand, Narita Brian...

With a passionate fire burning in her 
heart, she walked away from the scene.
